rootCause: X showed an explicit Alert and queued router.replace. Its finally cleared leavingRef before Expo delivered the queued beforeRemove, causing a second Alert.

Replaying the parent REPLACE through child navigation.dispatch injected source=capture-key. The installed parent StackRouter rejected that foreign source and native core handled the targeted action with unchanged state.
An empty close concurrent with startNewDraft could delete first and allow initialization to recreate the empty draft after departure.
Photos could change while confirmed persistence was awaiting native cache IO, allowing departure with the older photo snapshot.
fix: Public usePreventRemove owns only the focused route removal, one confirmation and one original native action.
Before and after IO, verify captured owner/SDK occurrence, Auth generation, mounted/focus/privacy/photo revision, root container instance/readiness and focused native route key path.
Replay the exact action object through useNavigationContainerRef().current.dispatch, preserving target, absent source and the native opaque visited-route symbol; no general bypass flag.
Await draft initialization before empty deletion or photo persistence, keep actual owned draft ID, stay on real IO failure, and allow an explicit current retry.
Increment local departure revision on committed photo changes; a stale save cannot close the screen, while a new explicit confirmation persists all current photos.
The same local hook supports Pricing autosave without a confirmation through confirmExit:false; Pricing changes and tests are independently owned and reported.
